entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: A healer and eugenicist who studies phthisis, overthrows the Halcyon council, and becomes the god-ruler of Phyrexia.

entities.name: Glacian
entities.description: A brilliant Thran artificer, husband of Rebbec, stabbed with a powerstone by Gix.

entities.name: Rebbec
entities.description: Wife of Glacian and the city's main architect, torn between her husband and attraction to Yawgmoth; she finally locks the portal to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: An Untouchable who stabs Glacian and leads rebellions on Halcyon, later commander of the Caves of the Damned.

entities.name: Dyfed
entities.description: A planeswalker who opens a permanent portal to Phyrexia for Yawgmoth and is later pithed by him.

entities.name: Xod
entities.description: A healer who gives Yawgmoth the idea of a metal serum and later reappears as a Phyrexian warrior.

entities.name: Halcyon
entities.description: The Thran city where Yawgmoth rises to power and which is destroyed by the death cloud.

entities.name: Caves of the Damned
entities.description: Caves under Halcyon where the Untouchables were banished, later turned into sterile laboratories and the site of the portal to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: An artificial world blending artifice and life, named for phyresis, that Yawgmoth makes his paradise.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane ruled by the Thran.

entities.name: The Thran
entities.description: The ancient builders of machines and artifacts who ruled Dominaria until the empire fell to internal struggle.

entities.name: Thran Alliance
entities.description: An alliance of dwarves, minotaur, cat-folk, elves, Viashino, artifact creatures and humans against Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Untouchables
entities.description: Thran banished to the Caves of the Damned under the city.

entities.name: Halcyte Guard
entities.description: The guard of Halcyon, which Yawgmoth comes to control completely.

entities.name: Null Sphere
entities.description: A device captured by Yawgmoth and launched into the air to turn the artifact creatures of the Thran Alliance against their masters.

entities.name: Phthisis
entities.description: A disease, named by Yawgmoth, caused by powerstones.

entities.name: Thran-Phyrexian War
entities.description: The war that ended the Thran Empire.

entities.name: Battle of Megheddon Defile
entities.description: A battle in which Yawgmoth uses the Null Sphere to slaughter the Thran Alliance army.

events.summary: Glacian is stabbed with a powerstone by Gix during a riot in the Mana Rig and falls ill; Rebbec recalls the exiled Yawgmoth to heal him.
events.quote: His wife Rebbec uses her influence as the city's main architect to recall the exiled eugenicist Yawgmoth

events.summary: Yawgmoth discovers that powerstones cause phthisis; Gix learns it and escapes, wanting vengeance for his people.
events.quote: Gix escapes upon hearing this, wanting vengeance for his people.

events.summary: Gix leads a massive rebellion, which Yawgmoth quells by offering free serum; he is made a member of the council.
events.quote: Yawgmoth manages to quell the revolt by offering free serum to the Untouchables.

events.summary: Yawgmoth sends infected people into the Caves and brings healthy ones to the city, using this to eliminate enemies.
events.quote: is using this to eliminate his enemies from the city.

events.summary: The planeswalker Dyfed visits Glacian and Yawgmoth talks her into finding a plane for his paradise.
events.quote: Dyfed agrees to find a plane where Yawgmoth can build his own paradise.

events.summary: Yawgmoth uses an artifact based on Glacian's designs and the Halcyte Guard to crush Gix's second riot and bully him into obedience.
Delegates of the allied nations denounce Yawgmoth's atrocities; he survives a tied council vote, then overthrows the council and imprisons the elders and delegates.
events.quote: After this, Yawgmoth overthrows the council and imprisons its elders, as well as the delegates.

events.summary: Dyfed sends the captured elders to Mercadia at Rebbec's summons, at Glacian's urging.
events.quote: The planeswalker brings them to Mercadia , along with about two hundred of their goblin servants.

events.summary: Dyfed opens a permanent portal to an artificial world, which Yawgmoth names Phyrexia and binds himself to, becoming a god.
events.quote: Yawgmoth binds himself to the plane, becoming a god while staying there.

events.summary: Yawgmoth wins the Battle of Megheddon Defile with the Null Sphere and drops a stonecharger on the fallen army.
events.quote: he drops a stonecharger , the magical equivalent of a nuclear warhead, on the fallen army.

events.summary: Yawgmoth stabs Dyfed in the brain with a powerstone dagger, pithing her so she cannot planeswalk.
events.quote: Yawgmoth stabs her in the brain with a powerstone dagger

events.summary: Yawgmoth's war caravel survives the Alliance's counterattack; a Phyrexian warrior carries him back and he recognizes Xod.
events.quote: Yawgmoth realizes it is Xod, the healer who gave him the inspiration for the serum so many years before.

events.summary: Glacian dies; Rebbec finds the powerstone halves Yawgmoth hid inside him, and she disguises her love for Yawgmoth as hatred.
events.quote: she disguises her love for Yawgmoth as hatred.

events.summary: Rebbec frees Glacian's body, kills the vat priests, and gives Dyfed the peace of death.
events.quote: giving Dyfed the peace of death as well.

events.summary: Yawgmoth has stonechargers dropped on all opposing armies on Dominaria, obliterating them.
The Thran Temple falls to the death cloud, and Yawgmoth persuades Halcyon's remaining inhabitants to flee to Phyrexia, where they are killed and made into newts.
events.quote: they try to flee again but are killed and used to create new Phyrexian newts .

events.summary: Rebbec reunites the powerstone, hears Glacian's voice, and places it on the pedestal to close the portal, locking Yawgmoth out of Dominaria.
events.quote: She goes to the pedestal room and does that, even though Yawgmoth pleads her not to from the other side of the portal.

events.summary: Rebbec walks out of the Caves into the white cloud covering Halcyon.
events.quote: Rebbec ascends the stairs out of the Caves of the Damned and walks into the white cloud covering Halcyon.
